title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Nasdaq closed at a record high Monday (+1.1%), S&P 500 +0.7%, Dow +0.2%, on a resilient-economy narrative.
Markets: 10-year Treasury yield hit a fresh two-decade high of 5.31% as strong services-sector data stokes bets the Fed may need to hike aggressively to curb inflation.
Markets: Brent crude eased ~2% to $100.32/bbl after G-7 nations agreed to a coordinated crude-oil release.
Companies: C.H. Robinson to buy rival freight broker RXO for ~$5.8B (stock+cash); RXO shares jumped, C.H. Robinson shares fell over 10%.
Companies: Schneider Electric to acquire industrial-software maker PTC for ~$23B to capitalize on AI-driven demand; PTC shares soared 30%+.
Companies: Nvidia-backed startup Reflection is prepping a powerful open-weight AI model aimed at challenging US and Chinese rivals alike (Axios scoop).
Macro/Policy: Regional bank stocks drawing fresh scrutiny as rates climb, echoing 2023's SVB-driven crisis fears, though analysts note key differences this cycle.
Macro/Policy: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan speaks today; Treasury auctions $58B in 3-year notes; August trade balance data due.
